title: Build verification
description: Whether an executable or a source snapshot matches a trusted build record, and each digest that does not.

title: Image verification
description: Whether an image, local or in a registry, matches its record and its build, and whether its signature and SBOMs are acceptable.

title: Faults
description: Every fault one declaration has, each as structured data: the rule it breaks, where, what was found and what is allowed. An empty list means the declaration is acceptable.

title: Fleet
description: Every service whose record a sweep reads in the checkouts a platform engineer names, with each component it pins. It is fed by Generating's published event Service build applied, whose durable form is the committed record.

title: Pin standing
description: Each component pin of one service, with the standing that the digest lifecycle gives it.

title: Compiler identity
description: The version and build identity of the compiler that runs, which is the identity it writes into a record.

title: Fill catalog
description: Every fill in the project that implements one slot, with its collection and its qualification standing, so an author or an agent can reuse a fill before writing a new one.

title: Fill qualification
description: Each fill the declaration binds, with its qualification standing, whether it fits its binding, and why it is not qualified when it is not.

title: Drift
description: Every difference between a service's record and the files beside it, and whether the record itself can be trusted.

title: Plan
description: The change one generation run would make: one action per generated file, and the new record. Make a plan saves it, show prints it, and apply carries it out.

title: Declarable inputs
description: Every input a declaration may give the active component set of one archetype: each component, each setting with its type, its allowed values, its default and whether it is optional, and each slot with its contract. Checking reads the same registry, so the two cannot disagree.

title: Component catalog
description: Every component of the active registry with the ports it provides and requires and the slots it offers, so a platform engineer can find a provider or a slot.

title: Component consumers
description: Each recorded service that uses a component, with the component's stage and sunset and the date until which the service accepts it.
